title: Plasma Sphere with Ghost Horses
description: A glowing plasma globe sits on a wooden table, its glass sphere filled with vibrant electrical arcs in purple, cyan, and pink. Inside, two translucent neon horses in green, blue, and purple gallop around a central glowing orb while bright lightning bolts and sparks burst outward against a dark twilight landscape with hills and water.
prompt: A glowing plasma ball on a wooden table by a lakeside at dusk, inside the transparent sphere two ghostly neon horses in bright cyan, green and purple gallop around a central red core, dramatic purple and white electrical arcs and sparks exploding outward, vibrant energy effects, dark moody background with hills and reflective water, highly detailed digital painting
